body: In this paper, we study federated optimization for solving stochastic variational inequalities (VIs), a problem that has attracted growing attention in recent years. Despite substantial progress, a significant gap remains between existing convergence rates and the state-of-the-art bounds known for federated convex optimization. In this work, we address this limitation by establishing a series of improved convergence rates. First, we show that, for general smooth and monotone variational inequalities, the classical Local Extra SGD algorithm admits tighter guarantees under a refined analysis…
summaryZh: 苹果机器学习团队针对联邦学习中的随机变分不等式（VIs）问题，提出了一种改进的收敛速率分析方法。通过对Local Extra SGD算法的深入研究，该工作在平滑且单调的变分不等式场景下，实现了比现有方法更紧密的收敛保证，为分布式优化算法的效率提升提供了理论支持。
